steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: assert-no-stops
steps.eval: if (window.__store.getState().panoTourStops.length !== 0) throw new Error('Expected 0 stops after clear, got ' + window.__store.getState().panoTourStops.length)

steps.name: add-two-stops
steps.eval: window.__store.setState({ panoTourStops: [{ id: 'journey-stop-1', label: 'Living Room', position: [9, 3] }, { id: 'journey-stop-2', label: 'Kitchen', position: [4, 3] }], panoTourActiveId: 'journey-stop-1' })

steps.name: assert-two-stops-added
steps.eval: (() => { const stops = window.__store.getState().panoTourStops; if (stops.length !== 2) throw new Error('Expected 2 stops, got ' + stops.length); if (stops[0].label !== 'Living Room') throw new Error('Stop 1 label mismatch: ' + stops[0].label); })()

steps.name: assert-stop-markers-in-plan
steps.eval: (() => { const circles = document.querySelectorAll('.plan-screen svg circle'); if (circles.length < 2) throw new Error('Expected at least 2 circles in plan SVG (stop markers), found: ' + circles.length); })()

steps.name: assert-tour-modal-shows-stops
steps.eval: (() => { const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.modal-overlay button')).filter(b => b.textContent?.includes('Living Room') || b.textContent?.includes('Kitchen')); if (btns.length < 2) throw new Error('Expected Living Room + Kitchen buttons in tour modal, got: ' + btns.length); })()

steps.name: assert-active-stop
steps.eval: if (!window.__store.getState().panoTourActiveId) throw new Error('panoTourActiveId should be set when tour is open')

steps.name: assert-stop-tabs-visible-mobile
steps.eval: (() => { const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.modal-overlay button')).filter(b => b.textContent?.includes('Living Room') || b.textContent?.includes('Kitchen')); if (btns.length < 2) throw new Error('Stop tabs not visible on mobile, found: ' + btns.length); })()
